test_IMAS_geometry_roundtrip: test the IMAS geometry input output roundtrip by loading equilibrium data and verifying TORAX simulation converts back to IDS
load_IMAS_equilibrium_data: load an IMAS equilibrium IDS from a netCDF file or IMASdb URI using the loader module
build_TORAX_config_from_dict: build a ToraxConfig object from a dictionary using the Pydantic model configuration
prepare_TORAX_simulation: prepare a TORAX simulation from a ToraxConfig and return the initial sim state and post processed outputs
convert_TORAX_state_to_IMAS_equilibrium: convert a TORAX simulation state and post processed outputs into an IMAS equilibrium IDS
